title: First compatible term index
statement: Let $\varphi$ be a disjunctive normal form on $n$ coordinates, and let $\rho$ assign each coordinate one of the states free, fixed at $1$, or fixed at $-1$. If at least one term of $\varphi$ is compatible with $\rho$, the selected index is the least index in the ordered list of terms whose term is compatible with $\rho$.
hypotheses_covered: A disjunctive normal form on $n$ coordinates

At least one term is compatible with the restriction
